scope: Post-audit independent correctness and breadth review of 12 synthetic dossiers, both reports separately. Not a fresh blind reliability benchmark.

status_definitions.tested: Executed audit or mechanism-test evidence is retained; execution_kind distinguishes them. This reviewer did not rerun Lean.
status_definitions.designed: An explicit rule exists but the selected dossier does not establish execution of this branch.
status_definitions.missing: No executed coverage established in this review; often a declared limit rather than a defect.
